result_text:
Any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock` now counts as mock resources, at any depth and with backslash paths too. The codeanalyzer tests pass, including a new test for the new cases.

**Change:** In `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`, `addTestConventions` had two mock-folder rules. The `__mock` rule and the `mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+` rule are now one rule: `.*/(__)?mock[^/\\]*/.*`. The `[^/\\]*` part lets the rest of the folder name be anything except a path separator. It also makes the suffix optional, which is why a bare `mock/` folder now matches. The match stays within one folder name, so `remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, `mock.java` and `mockery.java` still don't match. `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` still match.

**New test:** `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java` checks the positive cases (the elasticsearch path, `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe`, `mock模拟`, the existing folder names, and backslash paths) and the negative cases.

**Tests:** `ScopingConventionsTest` (2 tests) and `SourceFileFilterTest` (6 tests) pass with `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer test`. Nothing is committed.
